oracle_policy: The execution context must receive inputs_only.json and the referenced model skill only. It must not read 02_ORACULO, Oracle_Obligatorio, Oracle_WOW, expected results, previous scored outputs, or this conversation's oracle-bearing messages until both raw outputs for the case are frozen.
raw_output_policy: Preserve the complete unmodified raw response separately for each case/model and bind it to case_id, model_id, input digest, model revision and output digest.
normalization_policy: Normalize only after raw output freeze. Common comparison fields: case, root_cause, invariants, mandatory_findings, gaps, false_positives, proposed_repair, evidence, score, status.
